# EveryCentCalc

> 87 free financial calculators for freelancers, side hustlers, real estate investors, and small business owners. Updated for 2026 IRS tax brackets.

## What This Site Does

EveryCentCalc provides free online financial calculators. All calculations happen in the browser. No data is stored or transmitted.

## Key Facts

- **87 calculators** across 7 categories
- **2026 IRS tax brackets** and rates for all tax calculations
- **100% free** with no accounts or paywalls
- **100% private** with all calculations done client-side
- Built for the US market targeting freelancers, side hustlers, and small business owners
